title: Street Intersection Finder: Where Streets Cross
description: Search for possible junction matches using two street names; independently verify any crossing and coordinates.
summary_sentence: Text-search results are possible matches, not verified intersections between road geometries.
quick_answer: This workspace sends two street names and an optional town to Nominatim and displays possible matches. It does not calculate whether road geometries intersect, so verify any result independently.
steps_intro: Search for a possible match, then verify the actual crossing on an authoritative map:

body.t: Search for a possible junction to investigate; confirm the exact meeting point separately.
The search does not prove that streets cross. Verify using a map with road geometry or an authoritative local source.
A search result can be a lead for historical or local research, but the correct junction needs independent verification.
Do not use an unverified search result as a precise pickup point; confirm it with the driver and a reliable map.
Common street names may produce several text matches. A listed alternative is not necessarily a junction; verify it.
No search result does not prove that the roads never intersect. Try alternate spellings and check an authoritative map.
